_note: Each scenario's seed was found by brute-force search: run newRun(seed) then a single direct springTrap/openChest/encounterDot call and keep the first seed whose result matches the scenario's target outcome (a sprung/damaging trap, an opened chest, a plain Table Four row, a Faerie encounter, and a Disease/Poison affliction). 'springTrap'/'openChest'/'encounterDot' are internal (non-validated) actions, mirroring action-script.combat.json's 'startCombat' precedent — the harness clones/rehydrates-rng/persists by hand, the same shape applyAction itself uses.

chargenDivergence.rationale: ABIL-02: as chargen seed 1 — Climbing dropped outright; its table position is now Second Wind (an active), which lives in c.abilities (secondWind) instead of c.skills. springTrap's dodge never read Climbing. USER RULING D/G (Phase 54-07 fit, BAND-02, 2026-09-21): HERO_HP_SCALE fitted to 1.25 scales maxWP/wp at chargen (round(canon * 1.25)); FOOD_CLOCK held at 1.5 scales the class's starting rations (round(canon * 1.5)). Measured live via newRun(seed) vs the frozen prototype sandbox, never hand-typed.

floorFeatureShift.rationale: USER RULING D/G (Phase 54-07 fit, BAND-02, 2026-09-21): ENCOUNTER_DOTS fitted to { base: 7, perDepth: 0.3 } (from identity { base: 9, perDepth: 1 }) changes difficultyCurve(depth).dots — genFloor's feature-scatter loop (engine/maze.js) walks the SAME rng.shuffle(far) result but assigns the first dots array slots to the 'dot' feat before moving on to tele/chest/trap/climb/gorge, so a smaller dots count shifts every later feature category's starting index by the same delta, remapping which cells land on which feat — the rng cursor itself is UNCHANGED (the shuffle runs once regardless of dots; nothing after it draws more or fewer times), so this is a pure, deterministic re-mapping, not new randomness. This scenario never navigates the maze (combat/casting starts immediately at chargen), so only the BOOT floor (depth 1) is measured. Measured live via newRun(seed) vs the frozen prototype sandbox, never hand-typed.
